bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $218–221 低点

read.en: Coherent fell 12.5% on Oct 22 to $207.82, trading between $204.38 and $224.56 on 1.8 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($228.4), 10-day ($254.7), 30-day ($288.0) and 100-day ($315.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($295.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($287.43), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: Coherent 10月22日下跌 12.5%，收于 $207.82，盘中区间 $204.38–224.56，成交量为平均水平的 1.8 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$228.4）、10 日（$254.7）、30 日（$288.0）和 100 日均线（$315.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$295.3）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$287.43），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The drop broke the $235.5, $231.6 and $218–221 supports (Oct 15, Oct 16, Oct 20 and Jul 29 lows), which now turn into resistance; the low stopped at the $204.6 Feb 17 low. Resistance is $217.8–220.7, then $228.4–231.6 (5-day, Oct 16 low) and $244. Support is $204.4–204.6, then $200. A close above $220.7 would target $231.6; a close below $204 would open $200.

r.en: Oct 20 low $217.8; Jul 29 low $220.7, now resistance
